resource.title: High Speed Communication Circuits and Systems (MIT 6.976, Spring 2003) — MIT OpenCourseWare
resource.access: MIT OpenCourseWare 免费开放，无需注册；提供 19 讲 Lecture Notes（PDF）、6 次作业、考试与两个设计项目，课程指定教材需自行购买（Lee《The Design of CMOS RF ICs》、Razavi《RF Microelectronics》）
resource.covers: 讲义目录原文含：Transmission Line Theory、S-parameters and Impedance Transformers、Generalized Reflection Coefficient, Smith Chart, Passives、High Speed Broadband Amplifiers、Narrowband Amplifiers（谐振/调谐放大器）、Noise Modeling、Low Noise Amplifiers、Mixers（混频器）、Voltage Controlled Oscillators 及振荡器噪声、High Speed Frequency Dividers、Integer-N/Advanced Frequency Synthesizers（锁相环与频率合成）、Basics of Wireless Communication（收发机结构概述）。不覆盖：高频功率放大器（PA）、调幅检波与调频鉴频（仅作为收发机概念提到，未单列）——这两块简介内容要靠 Stanford EE 133 方向补

courses.prereq_text: Prerequisites: ELENG 64, ELENG 66, and EL ENG 105.
courses.scope_text: Catalog Description: Analysis and design of electronic circuits for communication systems, with an emphasis on integrated circuits for wireless communication systems. Analysis of noise and distortion in amplifiers with application to radio receiver design. Power amplifier design with application to wireless radio transmitters. Radio-frequency mixers, oscillators, phase-locked loops, modulators, and demodulators.
courses.hours_text: Units: 4 — Fall/Spring: 3 hours of lecture, 1 hour of discussion, and 3 hours of laboratory per week

courses.prereq_text: Should have completed all of the following requirements: Courses — Circuits II 4 Units and Fundamentals of Analog Integrated Circuit Design 3-4 Units (EE 214A)
courses.scope_text: Design, testing, and applications of Radio Frequency (RF) electronics: Amplitude Modulation (AM), Frequency Modulation (FM) and concepts of Software Define Radio (SDR) systems. Practical aspects of circuit implementations are developed; labs involve building and characterization of subsystems as well as integration of a complete radio system and a final project. Total enrollment limited to 30 students.

courses.school: 河北师范大学（中国大学MOOC）
courses.prereq_text: 预备知识：需要具备电路分析、模拟电子技术基础、高等数学和三角函数等基础知识。（常见问题：'学习本课程需要具备哪些先学课程？电路分析、模拟电子技术基础以及高等数学等课程'）
courses.scope_text: 本慕课由绪论、高频电路基础、高频小信号放大器、高频功率放大器、正弦波振荡器、振幅调制与解调及混频电路、角度调制与解调电路、反馈控制电路等8章组成 ... 通过对模拟通信系统中发送设备和接收设备单元电路的学习，使学习者系统地掌握其基本概念和工作原理的分析和设计方法。
courses.hours_text: 57 个教学点／57 个教学微视频，约 7 小时视频（课程概述原文：'将本课程划分为57个教学点，对应57个教学微视频，并通过7个小时实时讲解的微视频再现其精华'）

notes: 候选判断：H.1.4 三条证据一致 —— Berkeley EE 142 先修含 EL ENG 105（微电子器件与电路/模拟）、Stanford EE 133 要求 EE 114 Fundamentals of Analog Integrated Circuit Design、河北师大 MOOC 预备知识明列“模拟电子技术基础”→ supported。H.1.3 由 Berkeley EE 142 先修 ELENG 66（原 EECS 16A，信号与系统/线性代数）支持 → supported。E.1.2（微波工程与天线）三门课都没有作为先修 → not_mentioned。E.2.3（通信原理）也没有：三门课讲的是通信电路而非通信原理课，未列 → not_mentioned。另核对到 MIT 6.6020 High-Frequency Integrated Circuits（https://catalog.mit.edu/subjects/6/，3-3-6 units，'Prereq: 6.2080'，内容原文含 'RFIC: on-chip passives, transmission lines, S-parameters, Smith chart, transceivers'），先修 6.2080 本身要求 6.2000，是 H.1.4→E.1.3 的又一条证据，因每技能限 3 门未列入 courses。Stanford EE 133 的 'Total enrollment limited to 30 students' 属选课限制，不影响先修判定。
